items.title: Apollo limits redemptions as withdrawal requests hit 14.7% - Bloomberg
items.summary: Investing.com -- Apollo Global Management LLC (NYSE:APO) is limiting redemptions from its flagship private credit fund for the third consecutive quarter, as investors continue a broader retreat from the direct lending market.
